label: The composition step is real otherness plus reception, and stage (b) supplies real otherness
paraphrase: Premise-free, over every grades frame and principle sort. (1) The content form of the second unde (89d82643) gives its real-otherness form. (2) Real otherness of whatever is not esse tantum, with the real-otherness form, gives back the content form. (3) If at most one being has its esse really identical with its essence, and some such being is esse tantum, then whatever is not esse tantum has real otherness. So the composition step bundles (i) real otherness, whose De ente route is stage (b) through at-most-one (a576300f), with (ii) reception given real otherness. Formally immediate; it locates the load, it does not supply warrant.
